_doc: THE geo-fence declaration (ticket #1102), one source of truth. Public requests to the Caddy public edge (infra-sec_caddy-public, the only public HTTPS terminator) are served only when the client country is in allowed_countries; every other client gets 403 (HTML: an explanatory page, other clients: plain 'Forbidden'). Rendered by infra-sec_caddy-public/src/caddyfile-public.nix; the image bakes the country database at build time (Dockerfile ARGs must equal db.url and db.sha256 here; guard: _shared/test/geo-fence-guard.sh). Nothing is downloaded at runtime; .github/workflows/geo-fence-refresh.yml proposes a newer pinned database monthly.
_allowed_doc: EU27, EEA/EFTA (IS LI NO), UK and Crown dependencies, CH, other European countries and territories (AD AL AX BA FO GI MC MD ME MK RS SJ SM UA VA XK), plus US. Excluded on purpose: RU BY (sanctioned, high abuse), TR GE AM AZ (transcontinental). An address the database cannot place is denied (fail closed).
_exempt_doc: WireGuard mesh (10.0.0.0/24, fd0c:1d00::/64), wg-public (10.1.0.0/24) and loopback bypass the country check. Mail (imap/smtps SNI), MX and the raw passthrough tier are layer4 and never reach this HTTP check.

global_hosts.vpn.diegonmarcos.com: WireGuard bootstrap protocol endpoint (clients roam worldwide)
global_hosts.www.diegonmarcos.com: public read-only HTML (architect ruling 2026-10-22: only sign-in and private access is fenced)

edge_terminated.reason: bearer/cookie-gated container path host; terminated at the edge so the country fence sees the client, then proxied to the hub which keeps its own gate

_global_doc: Every other edge host is fenced by default (fail closed for new hosts): auth, account, mcp, c3-pvt, suite, nexus, maps and anything added later. Ruling 2026-10-22: public read-only HTML hosts (www, the apex, linktree) and the protocol hosts stay global; auth, account, mcp and c3-pvt stay fenced.
